prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Redraw the referenced White Buda game sprite sheet with CRISP high contrast pixel art. Exactly 4 columns x 3 rows, twelve isolated fullbody figures facing RIGHT, real transparent background, wide gutters. Preserve Drupa bald stocky belly bearded identity and white draped robe. He is made of white light, NOT flesh: solid clean white lit planes with decisive saturated cobalt-blue shadow shapes and sharp fine dark blue contours defining face, beard, hands, robe folds. NO fuzzy halo, bloom, haze, blur, airbrushing, particles, anti-aliased glow, washed-out details. Large detailed pixel sprites. All standing figures SAME full upright height; punches MUST remain UPRIGHT with almost straight legs, head same height as idle, absolutely NO squat, crouch, lunge, wide low stance. Row1: upright guard; upright walk nearfoot forward; upright walk farfoot forward; floating seated lotus. Row2: upright punch windup fists high; upright near-arm punch horizontally right chest-height torso rotating legs nearly straight; upright opposite far-arm punch right chest-height legs nearly straight; standing sky-call one hand overhead. Row3: upright lowkick windup; upright lowkick foot extended right near floor torso upright; standing hurt; upright punch recovery into guard. No text, floor, grid, beams or effects. Keep sprites isolated. 2048x1536 preferred.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create pixel-art game animation sheet for Drupa's second punch. Reference image is identity/outfit source only. Exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, eight isolated fullbody figures facing RIGHT with transparent background and wide gutters. Top row red varsity white sleeves black trousers red sneakers, bottom row loose heavyweight dark purple shirt black shorts white sneakers. Same bald stocky bearded man with round belly. Consistent head and body size. Four coherent frames of a natural REAR/FAR ARM cross punch: 1 guard with rear fist beside cheek and near hand guarding; 2 rotate torso and rear shoulder toward opponent while elbow unfolds; 3 full rear-arm cross punch extended right at chest height, near hand guards chin, natural shoulders wrists and elbows; 4 retract punching hand halfway returning to guard. Feet stay in same stance, rear heel pivots, NO jumping, no squatting, no stretched arms. Face always right, no left-facing head. Preserve body mass and clothes. No wristbands on purple skin. Crisp clean pixel contours and detailed shading to match reference, no effects, floor, text, shadow or grid.

Create a NEW production pixel art sprite sheet, not a recolor. Reference is ONLY the White Buda character identity and white/cobalt palette. Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, 6 isolated whole-body sprites on true transparent background. Bald bearded stocky man made of solid brilliant white light, white robe with crisp cobalt blue shadow shapes. SHARP outlines no glow blur or haze. Character STANDS TALL throughout: straight vertical legs, feet only SHOULDER WIDTH apart, hips directly above ankles, knees almost locked straight, head always at identical height. DO NOT reuse the reference crouching wide-legged punch poses. Every pose uses the SAME upright standing lower body and same height. Row1: 1 upright relaxed fighting guard; 2 upright torso-twist punch windup; 3 standing tall near-arm punch extended horizontally to right at shoulder height. Row2: 1 standing tall opposite far-arm punch extended right with other arm guarding face; 2 standing tall punch retracting to guard; 3 standing tall hands returning to guard. All looking and facing RIGHT. Keep Drupa heavy broad torso, big belly and recognizable beard. No squatting, no horse stance, no crouching, no lunges, no bent knees, no wide splayed legs. Large full-body sprites separated by wide blank transparent gutters, no floor, no lettering, no effects. Consistent anatomical scale.
